Technical SEO Audit Checklist for Google Crawling and Indexing

Indexing Checks

Ranking Signal Checks

Title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, schema markup, image alt text, Core Web Vitals, mobile UX, topical depth, anchor text, and conversion-focused CTA placement.
